description: This file provides functions to register and manage a custom backend in PyTorch, specifically for the 'privateuse1' dispatch key. It includes functions to rename the backend, generate methods for tensors, modules, and storage, and retrieve custom device module functions.

classes.name: _DummyBackendModule
classes.description: A dummy backend module class with methods indicating backend status and device info.

classes.name: _DummyPrivateUse1Hook
classes.description: A dummy hook class for PrivateUse1 dispatch key, with methods indicating availability and context.

classes.name: _DummyDeviceGuard
classes.description: A dummy device guard class for PrivateUse1, with method to get device type.

methods.name: rename_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Renames the privateuse1 backend to a specified name and updates internal state.

methods.name: _check_register_once
methods.description: Checks if a module attribute is already registered, raises error if so.

methods.name: _normalization_device
methods.description: Normalizes device input to a device index for the custom backend.

methods.name: _generate_tensor_methods_for_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Generates tensor methods to check backend type and convert tensors to the backend.

methods.name: _generate_module_methods_for_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Generates module methods to move modules to the custom backend.

methods.name: _generate_packed_sequence_methods_for_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Generates methods for PackedSequence objects related to the custom backend.

methods.name: _generate_storage_methods_for_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Generates storage methods for the custom backend, including move and type checks.

methods.name: generate_methods_for_privateuse1_backend
methods.description: Automatically generates backend-related methods for tensor, module, storage, and packed sequence.

methods.name: _get_custom_mod_func
methods.description: Retrieves a custom device module function by name, raising error if not found.

methods.name: setup_privateuseone_for_python_backend
methods.description: Sets up the PrivateUse1 dispatch key for use as a Python backend, registering hooks, device guards, and modules.
